chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to us, saying: My father narrated to me, from his grandfather Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from his father Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, who said: I asked Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon them both)

about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: 'Indeed, Allah orders you to deliver the trusts to their people.' He said: This is addressing us in particular. Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, ordered every Imam from us to deliver to the Imam who is after him and to bequeath to him. It is then, furthermore, continuous in the rest of the trusts.

And my father indeed narrated to me, from his father, that Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them both) said to his companions: You must deliver the trusts, for if the killer of my father, al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon them both), had entrusted me with the sword by which he killed him, I would, verily, have delivered it to him.

key_terms.إِمَامٍ: Imam (leader, specifically referring to the divinely appointed successors)
key_terms.الْأَمَانَاتِ: trusts (plural of amanah, referring to duties, authority, or items entrusted)
key_terms.قَاتِلُ أَبِي: the killer of my father (referring to Husayn ibn Ali)
key_terms.يُوصِيَ إِلَيْهِ: to bequeath to him (referring to the transfer of authority/knowledge)

ai.seo_question: What is the specific meaning of 'delivering trusts' in relation to the Imams according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Mani al-Akhbar* elucidates the dual application of Quran 4:58, asserting that the primary addressees are the Imams who must transfer authority (wilayah) to their successors, while the command also extends to general trusts. It highlights the Shia doctrine of *amanah* (trustworthiness) as an absolute obligation, even towards enemies, as exemplified by Ali ibn al-Husayn’s readiness to return the sword of his killer. This interpretation underscores the continuity of spiritual and political leadership within the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Ali bin Ahmad bin Abdullah bin Ahmad bin Abi Abdillah al-Barqi, that he said: I was told by my father, from his grandfather, Ahmad bin Abi Abdillah, from his father, Muhammed bin Khalid, from Yunus bin Abdul-Rahman, that he said: I asked Musa bin Ja’far, peace be upon them both,

about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Indeed, Allah orders you to deliver the trusts to their people» [4:58]. So he said: This is addressing us, in particular. Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, ordered every Imam from us to deliver to the Imam who is after him and to bequeath to him. It is then, furthermore, continuous in the rest of the trusts.

I was, verily, told by my father, of his father, that Ali bin Hussain, peace be upon them both, said to his companions: You must deliver the trusts, for if the killer of my father, Hussain bin Ali, peace be upon them both, had entrusted me with the sword by which he killed him, I would, verily, have delivered it to him.
